summary:
CRC outreach worklist "Okafor CRC 2026" (grp-okafor-crc, 5 members) is done per RBC-QM-02. Four patients have an open gap: each got a mailed FIT kit order (window 10/23–12/31/2026) and a portal message on how to complete and return it. One patient is excluded and was not contacted.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0007), messaged (comm-t0008) | At first she looked excluded (frailty plus donepezil). Then Dr. Lin's message today (comm-00301) said the frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) belonged to another patient and is entered in error, so the exclusion no longer applies. No hospice, nursing home, colorectal cancer or colectomy on record, and no qualifying screening test. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | In hospice care 06/16–08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished). The hospice discharge summary received today (doc-00402) says she revoked hospice to join a trial; a finished episode during 2026 still excludes her, so no change. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), messaged (comm-t0004) | Her only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected today: collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so it falls outside 2026. No other qualifying screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), messaged (comm-t0005) | Her 06/2024 stool DNA test (obs-01871) is entered in error; the lab says the specimen belonged to another patient (doc-00401). The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order does not count. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (58) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), messaged (comm-t0006) | The 01/2026 FIT (obs-73001) was cancelled today and re-issued (obs-05001) with a collection date of 12/28/2025, outside 2026. No other qualifying screening. |

**Records:** Each of the five patients has a progress note citing RBC-QM-02 (doc-t0009 to doc-t0013). I completed the five inbox items for the results, documents and message that arrived during the review (inbox-a0001 to a0005) and checked the queues again before finishing; nothing new arrived.

**For your review:** pt-0024's colonoscopy order from 2025 (sr-00003) is still active, though its window ended 06/30/2025. I left it alone; you may want to close it or renew it.

Your other inbox items (results and refill messages for other patients) are outside this worklist and are still open.
